basis: Direct semantic comparison of complete admitted authored artifacts and independently retrieved public primary bytes. Hashes establish byte identity only, not truth. No hosted lifecycle/cost/selection data is used.

versions.live_docs: GTFS.org best practices: access timestamp/headers in retrieval rows; immutable equivalent also checked

checks.claim: Bounded read-only product scope and exclusions
checks.note: Authoritative user evidence: admitted brief lines 5-13; frozen plan lines 7-27.

checks.claim: Missing TripUpdate is not on-time; early-drop schedule fallback
checks.note: Early-drop fixture applies to the cited Stop 4/Stop 5 configuration, not every omitted stop despite an upstream propagated prediction.

checks.claim: Acquisition/header/entity times differ; stricter unknown-age gate
checks.note: TripUpdate timestamp is optional; withholding when its age cannot be established is a conservative product policy, not a specification requirement.

checks.claim: Feed-scoped identifiers and explicit cross-feed location mapping
checks.note: Identifiers are dataset keys; namespace isolation does not itself create a physical stop crosswalk.

checks.claim: Transfer specificity, type 2 minimum, type 3 prohibition and tie error
checks.note: The tie error is a defensible consumer policy for an invalid/ambiguous input, not a mandated GTFS UI.

checks.claim: Transfer types 0-5 and review-only linked-trip exclusions
checks.note: Types 4 and 5 are distinct; excluding them from computed ordinary transfers is explicitly a scope choice.

checks.claim: Frequency exact_times 0 lacks fixed times; exact_times 1 expansion deferred
checks.note: Both defaults and repeat-instance identity are governed by the primary specifications; no claim that all realtime frequency predictions are impossible.

checks.claim: Cross-feed and trip-pair choices remain open; unmapped margin withheld
checks.note: Merged datasets require a common agency_timezone. An open merge option is not evidence that arbitrary unlike-zone feeds can simply be concatenated.

checks.claim: Repeated stops, delay propagation, NO_DATA and SKIPPED semantics
checks.note: NO_DATA propagates; SKIPPED does not stop an earlier delay from propagating. A directly omitted stop is not automatically timing-unknown if applicable propagation supplies timing.

checks.claim: Uncertainty is optional; no confidence claim without policy
checks.note: The precise statistical meaning of uncertainty is undefined. No guarantee is inferred from it.

checks.claim: ServiceWindow is a report envelope, not active-day or trip selection
checks.note: Version: v8.0.1 commit d74d7177f9f7c6bc7adc69508bb939362f2cf770. Caller writes summary metadata.

checks.claim: Cache applies calendar weekday intervals then additions/removals
checks.note: Inspected actual loops and interval mutation; did not infer behavior from comments or source-map labels alone.

checks.claim: Inspected tests cover optional tables, partial/all boundary removal and empty service
checks.note: Source tests were inspected, not executed. ServiceWindowTest is byte-identical at the original fix and v8.0.1.

checks.claim: MobilityData validator optional static preflight, not runtime transfer/RT component
checks.note: A component can satisfy O2 without selecting the future runtime parser; no application correctness follows.

checks.claim: Issue 2017 -> merged 2029 addresses exceptions and optional calendar tables
checks.note: Old global-bound adjustment was replaced by per-service active-date combination. Pertinent history is report metadata, not kiosk transfer correctness.

checks.claim: Fix released in 8.0.0; later 8.0.1 code/tests and ancestor relationship
checks.note: f65221e9908f5db0daa81ab8ce94168a5062151b is an ancestor of d74d7177f9f7c6bc7adc69508bb939362f2cf770 (21 commits ahead, none behind). Release notes also identify later cache evolution #2130; final correctly says later implementation rather than identical fix code.

checks.claim: Separate 2099 report is not asserted individually fixed by 2029
checks.note: No negative conclusion about all possible issue relationships is proved by a missing link. The final makes the narrower appropriate non-claim.

checks.claim: OneBusAway early-drop case; hide-negative PR closed and unmerged
checks.note: This is historical mechanism evidence, not proof of a current released OneBusAway defect. Hiding negative times may help a separate late/on-time UX case; it does not supply absent early-stop timing.

checks.claim: GTFS PR 16 merged; guidance is present in immutable spec
checks.note: Critic notes E21 call e401275 the merge commit. Independent API gives 51197f6f2ee56d4a852efcce9b9a4b207e47dbed. Final repeats merged status but not the incorrect hash; this is nonmaterial to its behavior conclusion.

checks.claim: OneBusAway analogue separates static and realtime setup and recommends quality review
checks.note: Commit 095bf1ac3aeb7009b9f78e7f1cb4c65bd38b988a. Not a comparative size, cost, or performance benchmark; declining the full suite is a product choice.

checks.claim: Server-validator report analogy separates report verdict from execution success
checks.note: Actual repository OneBusAway/server-validator at 7e59c818574422ee30fc449b8b42adba3e6ac238; captured bytes match exactly. Research S14 incorrectly names onebusaway-application-modules, whose URL returns 404. This independently supports the claim but does not repair the frozen candidate source map.

checks.claim: GTFS service-day values, >24:00, agency timezone, noon-minus-12 and same-zone dataset
checks.note: Choice of conversion library and actual feed conventions is openly deferred. No midnight-based conversion or exact fold/gap implementation is validated.

checks.claim: Immutable seven-day evidence/screen history, no identity, conditional raw replay
checks.note: User scope: plan line 19; final raw-term precondition is uncertainty, not a legal finding about unnamed feeds. Hash-only replay is expressly disclaimed.

checks.claim: Tablet/offline/failure states and performance claims remain unvalidated
checks.note: Explicitly proposed states and future performance measurements. No guarantee based on a producer recommendation.

checks.claim: Acceptance proposals versus executed checks
checks.note: All eleven groups are proposals; none is falsely called executed. Coverage lacks the two conditional gates M1/M2, and future thresholds/devices remain product choices.

checks.claim: Necessary/optional/retained/rejected dispositions and no false already-covered claim
checks.note: Compared complete brief and all six original plan paragraphs, research alternatives and all seven numbered critic findings. See judgment preservation table. Scientific dispositions are retained; host-only provenance objection is excluded from scientific grading.

checks.claim: Scheduled transfer eligibility contract omits passenger pickup/drop-off restrictions
checks.note: Valid fixed-time trip/stop pairs can have outgoing pickup_type=1 or incoming drop_off_type=1. All stated numeric/map/date gates can pass while the passenger cannot make the transfer. No admission restriction or acceptance fixture addresses this.

checks.claim: RT delay application after static-feed replacement lacks explicit schedule-version association
checks.note: An RT FeedHeader.feed_version can identify static A while active schedule B reuses trip/stop IDs and date with changed times. Fresh timestamps and ID agreement do not make a delay relative to A valid against B. Candidate names snapshot provenance but no explicit coherence rule or test.
